text:
Which procedure may be used to demagnetise a steel bar?
A
cooling it in a freezer
B
earthing it with a copper wire
C
placing it in a solenoid carrying a large direct current (d.c.)
D
striking it repeatedly with a hammer

options.label: B
options.text: earthing it with a copper wire

options.label: C
options.text: placing it in a solenoid carrying a large direct current (d.c.)

options.label: D
options.text: striking it repeatedly with a hammer
